pierce.name: Pierce
pierce.desc: Thrust through one lane: hits the front-row and back-row enemy in the same lane (max 2 targets).

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: Heavy horizontal swing with +10% crit chance.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: Take a counter stance; ripostes the next incoming melee hit.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: Self battle cry: raises own damage for a few seconds.

sunder.name: Sunder
sunder.desc: Armor-breaking blow with a 50% chance to pierce the target's armor.

quake.name: Quake
quake.desc: Slam the ground, damaging all enemies in the area.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.desc: Raise a bulwark: taunt nearby foes and sharply boost own defense.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.desc: Project a team shield: raises all allies' defense.

snipe.name: Snipe
snipe.desc: A precise bolt with +50% accuracy against evasive targets.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.desc: Loose a volley of 5 arrows, each dealing partial damage.

pin.name: Pin
pin.desc: Pin the target in place, slowing it for several seconds.

mark.name: Mark
mark.desc: Mark a target: raises the whole team's crit chance against it.

LinhSon.name: The LinhSon
LinhSon.description: Ancient warriors rooted in mountain and forest, unyielding as stone, loyal to their ancestors.
LinhSon.passiveDescription: HP < 30% + Blessed full: +20% END/STR/AGI till end of combat

DeQuoc.name: The Republic Empire
DeQuoc.description: A modern civilisation reborn as an electro-steam-steel empire.

ThienLu.name: The Astopia
ThienLu.description: Mysterious nomads who live by the stars, carrying the sky in every footstep.
